errors.text_span: prognostizierte Änderungsrate der Wasserstoffpreise in verschiedenen Regionen Norddeutschlands
errors.evidence: This information is derived from the figure's caption in the source paper and external knowledge, not from the visual content of the figure itself. The figure's title is only 'Änderungsrate in %' (Rate of change in %) and the categories are abbreviations.

The statement that the negative values indicate a price decrease is an interpretation of the data. The chart itself only displays a 'Änderungsrate in %' (Rate of change in %) without explaining the meaning of negative values.
